item.title: Deploying Azure Red Hat OpenShift with Terraform
item.description: Are you looking for a way to deploy Azure Red Hat OpenShift without clicking through the portal every time? ARO is an Azure resource like anything else, which means Terraform can manage the whole cluster lifecycle. This post covers getting a cluster deployed into an existing VNet, and the two things that will stop your apply cold if you have not hit them before.
